title: The Risk of Margin Calls
summary: WHITE-L2-035: The Risk of Margin Calls.
body: This WHITE Level 2 lesson develops practical competence in The Risk of Margin Calls. Learners should compare alternatives, test assumptions and downside scenarios, and consider diversification, fees, liquidity, taxation, risk, time horizon and wider financial goals where relevant. Product rules, tax treatment and regulatory protections vary by jurisdiction and should be checked using current authoritative information or qualified local professionals. The objective is informed decision-making and structured thinking, not a recommendation to buy or sell a particular security, fund or investment product.
